# livekit_workspace_members (Data Source)

The members of a workspace, ordered by user ID: the users `livekit_project_member` can add to the workspace's private projects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "livekit_workspace_members" "this" {}

output "user_ids" {
  value = { for m in data.livekit_workspace_members.this.members : m.email => m.user_id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace (`wo_...`). Defaults to the workspace of the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `role` (String) `read`, `write`, `admin`, or `invited` for a pending invitee.
- `user_id` (String) The user's ID.
